News settings

These settings are for News only. Reply News keeps its own.

News plays the headlines githito.xapi collects from X every half hour. A story that has played does not play again.

One request on each line. The number of stories comes from Items under the video.

X is the source. The web and the papers from abroad play only when they are switched on here.

Type the name of your company, a medium, or a website, and press Search. Add what was found: its news plays first in every video. Press a name to remove it.

News plays no replies. Add an account here, and its posts play with the replies and comments under them (up to half of a video). Press Send to githito.xapi and then Submit: githito.xapi reads that account's replies from its next run, every half hour. Press a name to remove it, and send again.
